comment: Where each model in Web/CityView/public/models/trains/ came from. A model made with Meshy keeps its provenance here rather than in the GLB: the owner's export is re-written by tools/trains/bake_model.py (decimated, re-unwrapped, its colour baked into a new picture), so nothing of the original file survives to carry it. Meshy's terms ask that AI-generated output stay identifiable; this is where it is said.

n700st-cab.source: Meshy (text to 3D, then texturing), generated by the repository's owner on 2026-10-11
n700st-cab.prompt: Taiwan High Speed Rail N700ST train livery: glossy white body, orange and gray horizontal stripes along the side, dark tinted cockpit windows, silver gray undercarriage
n700st-cab.made_by: tools/trains/bake_model.py: welded, fitted to the city view's metres, collapsed to 8,000 triangles, unwrapped afresh, colour and occlusion baked from the dense model

n700st-car.source: the same Meshy model as n700st-cab
n700st-car.made_by: tools/trains/bake_model.py with its nose cut off and the body stretched to a full car's length; 6,000 triangles
